data.description:
## Purpose
Run the third dogfooding brainstorm session using /dso:brainstorm on the third target epic selected in the prerequisite task.

## Steps
1. Run /dso:brainstorm on target epic 3 (identified in prerequisite task)
2. Complete the Phase 1 Gate sequence through Understanding Summary, Intent Gap Analysis, and the completeness attestation sub-step
3. After the session, verify PRECONDITIONS event is accessible via .claude/scripts/dso ticket show <epic-id>
4. Check whether META_QUESTION signal was surfaced during Phase 1 Gate
5. Document the user answer — was it null (default / proceed) or a substantive correction?

## Done
- Brainstorm session 3 completed for target epic 3
- PRECONDITIONS event accessible
- Result documented as ticket comment on 745a-b46d: SESSION_3: epic=<id>, preconditions_accessible=<yes|no>, meta_question_fired=<yes|no>, user_answer=<answer|null>
data.title: Execute dogfooding brainstorm session 3 and capture PRECONDITIONS event path
